name: tua
description: Tua is the local-first archive for everything you make with AI: save with provenance, find it again across projects (S/M/L levels), bring in your history from Claude Code, Cowork and Claude Desktop without exports. Every atom is a markdown file in your own folder — no server, no account, nothing leaves your machine. Norwegian-language product.

arkivmappe.title: Arkivmappe / Archive folder
arkivmappe.description: Mappa der atomene dine ligger som markdown-filer. La stå tom, så spør Tua første gang (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive eller lokalt). · The folder where your atoms live as markdown files. Leave empty and Tua asks on first use.

auto_lagring.title: Automatisk fangst i Claude Code / Auto-capture in Claude Code
auto_lagring.description: Lagre lange svar, dokumenter du skriver (.md/.txt) og økt-sammendrag som atomer uten å spørre. Slå av om du bare vil lagre når du sier «lagre dette til Tua». · Save long answers, text documents you write and session summaries automatically. Turn off to save only on request.
